issue_context.summary: New+ shows ‘Nova+’ in Brazilian Portuguese; the reporter expects the masculine form ‘Novo+’, matching ‘arquivo’. A maintainer has transferred the correction to the localization team under GSH ADO bug 1412156.
known_information: The report targets PowerToys 0.92.1 and the New+ surface.
The affected language is Brazilian Portuguese.
The reporter's requested wording or meaning is the masculine form ‘Novo+’, matching ‘arquivo’.
The issue is labeled Loc-Sent To Team and the maintainer linked GSH ADO bug 1412156.
inferences: The report is sufficiently specific for localization correction; additional reporter diagnostics would not change ownership or the requested wording.
Because the correction is in the localization team’s tracked workflow, a separate PowerToys code plan would duplicate active work.
The issue should remain open until a shipped localization drop is checked; the ADO link alone does not prove that the corrected string has shipped.

The Loc-Sent To Team label and maintainer comment provide explicit ownership and a public tracking URL. The uncertainty is delivery timing, not root cause or the requested translation, so the lightweight judgment is handled work with an existing fix attempt and no executable Pulse action.
